Replaces the whole policy document: validates every range, stores version n+1 (n is the highest stored version, 0 when none) and raises the analytics-only SourcingPolicyPublished event in the same transaction. An omitted field takes its default, 0 (the lever is off); an empty body is 400. Every call publishes a NEW version, so it takes an Idempotency-Key like a POST: the same key with the same body replays the first answer for 24 hours instead of publishing twice; the same key with another request is 409 idempotency-key-reused. Searches that started before the publish keep the version they read.
